counterfactual_text: The tall box tips and settles on one side before its lower corner moves sideways.
positive_text: The lower corner moves sideways first, shifting the tall box past balance; the same box tips and settles on one side.
semantic_text: A tall cardboard box is pulled sideways at its lower corner, tips over, and remains lying on one side. Required visible entities: one tall cardboard box; level floor; the box lower corners. At the beginning: box: upright, intact, stable, and fully supported; lower pulling-side corner: visible and unobstructed. Required state changes: lower-corner position: displaced sideways; box balance: stable to unstable; box pose: upright to lying on one side. These event variables are allowed to change: lower-corner position; box center of mass projection; box orientation and support face. Preserve throughout: static side-view camera; cardboard-box identity and surface appearance; level floor and simple background; one tall cardboard box; the same lower corner and box identity; the same level support floor.
